notes.title: 12 HOURS v 1.2 with a 45% discount, and several important changes!

tags.balance_change: - more fragments of watches, since earlier it was almost impossible to collect all 12, now it is quite possible to do it :)
- the balance of the spawn of a miner's flashlight and batteries for it;

tags.bug: - previously it was possible to pick up an item from any distance - fixed;

notes.title: v 1.1 hotfix.
notes.content: Once again, the balance of enemies and character was held, a bug with random spawn was fixed, a bug that appeared after selecting 12 notes was corrected, weapon damage was increased, a bug with a miner's flashlight was fixed.

tags.balance_change: Once again, the balance of enemies and character was held
tags.bug: a bug with random spawn was fixed
tags.feature: a bug that appeared after selecting 12 notes was corrected

tags.bug: a bug with a miner's flashlight was fixed

notes.title: v 1.1. Balancing and innovations.

tags.feature: - added an indicator of the health of enemies;

tags.balance_change: - temporarily removed one of the enemies;
- balanced the power of damage of enemies and the main character;

tags.feature: - added a miner's flashlight, which is worn on the head. Now, if an enemy attacks you in the dark - you will see him, but first find a mining flashlight and batteries for it;
- now, every time, the player will spawn in a random place in the game world;

notes.title: Hotfix v 1.0. Localization.

tags.feature: - added simplified Chinese, Spanish and German;

tags.bug: - fixed bugs with the selection of weapons;
- fixed bugs with taking of some notes.

notes.title: 12 HOURS v 1.0, exit from early access and 12 HOURS OST PACK.

tags.bug: - solved the problem with failing the floor of the game world;

tags.feature: - change, selection and drop of weapons, inventory;
- added more notes with numbers, as it was very difficult to collect 12 hours.

notes.title: Immediate plans for development.
